outcome: availability of maternal and child healthcare services
cohort: Healthcare professionals (medical doctors, nurses, paramedical staff) working in public sector health facilities in Pakistan
finding: Maternal and child healthcare services, including C-section, perinatal care, and inpatient newborn care, in Pakistan may have been moderately affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: The provision of cesarean section was reported to be moderate to extremely affected by 20% of the participants.
